_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: BI-5A17505E adds propose_work_pattern_experiment_candidate: the governed origination seam that submits a validated 2x2 shadow Living Playbook experiment candidate as a deduplicated CoworkerCapabilityNeed so an operator can review and launch the hermetic experiment that legally promotes a work-pattern AuthorityBinding. submit_coworker_capability_need cannot carry it because that tool is caller-scoped view_platform self-assessment without manage_platform/registry_write authority, consequence:'authority' classification, promotion-policy ceiling enforcement, or build-replay-v1 fixture validation. Reuses registry_write; adds no new grant, core-tier entry, route, or DB table. Claim to check: work-pattern-experiment-candidate.test.ts and work-pattern-experiment-pack.test.ts prove invalid/inadmissible/fixtureless candidates are rejected and valid proposals write only CoworkerSelfAssessment + CoworkerCapabilityNeed, never AuthorityBinding or TaskRun. The prior 465-tool justification remains in the parent version.

registry.packFiles.reason: BI-5A17505E: work-pattern-experiment-pack.ts holds the single propose_work_pattern_experiment_candidate definition and handler. It is its own pack because coworker-capability-pack.ts serves caller-scoped view_platform self-assessment tools whereas experiment candidate origination is a manage_platform, consequence:'authority' Living Playbook governance seam; it registers once in pack-registry.ts with grants matching coworker-capability-tool-grants.ts spread into agent-grants.ts. The prior 110-file justification remains in the parent version.

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Adds the five names without which a core-tier client can start governed work but never finish it: update_backlog_item_status and record_execution_evidence (AGENTS.md s5 requires recording completion and its evidence, and core could create/triage/size/update but not close); trace_code_surface (a surface's implementation files and tests, pairing with search_code_graph which is already core); and claim_nonprod_environment_lease with release_nonprod_environment_lease together, since a session that can take the shared singleton lock but not release it blocks every other worktree and the CI gate. A client that cannot close its own work reaches for ?tier=full and pays the whole ~400-tool surface to recover two names. No effect on Claude Code or Codex, whose client-aware default is already full. Raise again only for a tool without which governed work cannot be finished; convenience stays behind search_tool_marketplace.
